summary: Desktop DigiLib UI flows were exercised successfully for home, search, catalog filtering, detail modal, demo login, borrowing, profile, and admin navigation. Mobile testing found horizontal overflow; the public FastAPI health probe returns 404. Google Apps Script and catalog/auth/loan data remain MOCKED local demo behavior.

critical.issue: Expected health endpoint returns HTTP 404 Not Found on the configured public backend URL.

ui_bugs.issue: At 390px viewport document.body.scrollWidth is 425px, causing horizontal clipping/overflow; search and category select do not fit together.

integration_issues.flow: Google Sheets/Apps Script synchronization and authentication
integration_issues.issue: UI displays sync status and accepts any demo login without calling Google Apps Script; borrowing is in-memory only.

action_items: Add/fix a public /api/health endpoint or align health checks with the implemented /api/status routes.
Fix mobile catalog toolbar responsiveness so body width does not exceed viewport.
Replace local demo data and permissive login with Google Apps Script/Sheets/Drive integration before production.
critical_code_review_comments: Admin navigation is publicly accessible without role/session enforcement.
The login handler ignores entered credentials and always creates an Andi session; this is only acceptable while explicitly MOCKED.
seed_data_creation: None; used existing local demo catalog and loan seed.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Desktop core flow covered. Recheck mobile catalog at 390px after CSS fix, then test real Apps Script integration and role-based admin access when configured.
test_credentials: Missing/empty /app/memory/test_credentials.md; demo login UI was used because credentials are not configured.
rca of the issue: Mobile overflow is caused by the catalog toolbar's fixed 145px select plus search control and container gaps/padding exceeding the 390px viewport. The health 404 is because backend/server.py defines /api/ and /api/status but no /api/health route.
